_comment: Hologram models. Boxes are [x0,x1, y0,y1, z0,z1] in fractions of the normalised bounding box (y up, front +z); a face goes to the first part whose box holds its centroid, else to the part with rest=true. bind names the live reading a part shows (holo/bindings.py). Rebake: ~/.local/share/bromigos/venv/bin/python tools/bake.py --preview
